title: The past continuous
subtitle: What was going on at a moment in the past
review: Written by Claude in the format of the French tense pages. Check the examples and the level.
intro: Use it for an action that **was in progress** at a time in the past: it had started, and it was **not finished yet**. It is the **background** of a story. The past simple tells what **happened**.

blocks.label: At a moment in the past
blocks.title: In the middle of an action

examples.fr: At eight o'clock I **was eating** breakfast.
This time yesterday we **were sitting** in class.
What **were** you **doing** at ten last night?
She **was walking** home when it **started** to rain.
We **were watching** TV when the lights **went** out.

examples.en: While + the long action. When + the short action.

blocks.label: Background
blocks.title: The scene at the start of a story

examples.fr: The sun **was shining** and the birds **were singing**.
It **was raining** and the wind **was blowing**.
People **were talking** and children **were running** everywhere.

blocks.label: Two actions at the same time
blocks.title: While …

examples.fr: While I **was reading**, my sister **was drawing**.
Mother **was cooking** while father **was washing** the car.

blocks.title: Pattern
blocks.note: The -ing spelling is the same as in the present continuous: *making*, *running*, *sitting*, *lying*.

blocks.title: Verbs that stay simple
blocks.text: The thinking and feeling verbs do not take -ing in the past either: **know, like, love, want, need, understand, believe**.

examples.en: Not: I was knowing the answer.

blocks.text: when, while, as, at that moment, at eight o'clock, this time yesterday, all day, all night, all morning …

examples.en: Yes, I was. / No, I wasn't.

examples.fr: **Past continuous**: in progress, not finished. *I was reading a book.*
examples.en: We do not know if I finished it.
From the first page to the last.

examples.fr: **Together**: *I was reading when she came in.*
examples.en: The reading is the long action. Her coming in is the short one.

examples.fr: **Two short actions**: *When she came in, I stood up.*
examples.en: First she came in, then I stood up: both past simple.
